notes: Only scan 079 and its two assigned witnesses were consulted. No OCR, recognition tool, other scan, previous reader output, or external research was used. The whole image was viewed once and each full-resolution half once; all running text, including agreed readings, was checked. Nineteen unique enhanced crops were made. The definit crop was reopened to assess the disputed parenthesis/letter arc; no place was recropped.

Line count 43 counts 21 main-text/display baselines (including the two rows of formula (12)), three added insertion baselines, six lines in the cancelled margin block, eight in the live margin note, three in the final caution, and the two separate page/folio number elements. The two short vertical equality strokes are a relation between diagram rows, not an extra text line.

The author’s grey writing fills the front of a plain sheet. The dark upper 39 is retained under the witness convention as mspage; the faint lower-left 78 is transcribed separately as a marginal foliation. No diagram other than formula (12), no drawing, and no watermark text require transcription.

The two long curved leaders attach X lisse et propre sur S, immediately before T fini étale, and classe de pi-conj. de immediately after une. The latter leader supplies the apparent left parenthesis; an independent opening parenthesis was not inferred. The apparent right closing parenthesis beside ss- remains doubtful because it may be part of g.

The mixed connector sequence in the extension display is deliberate diplomatic preservation: only the third connector has a small terminal head. Nothing was silently supplied to make all four into arrows.

The main text explicitly writes pi_2(S) → pi_1(fibre), while the slanted margin writes pi_1(S) → pi. The latter small 1 is clear and is retained, although the comparison with the preceding boundary map suggests an authorial index slip. The mathematics is a prompt for this comparison, not permission to change the ink.
The written phrase defines a class of pi-conjugate subgroups, with label L_i0. The adjective before L_i0 remains fermés/libre; grammar does not authorize removing a possible final s.

Only one closing parenthesis follows présume. The transcription retains the opening parenthetical state of both witnesses without inventing a second close. The next paragraph starts Si. The last line ends borne without completion beyond the leaf.

The author expressly qualifies the pi_2(S)=0 discussion with je présume and appends il faudrait quand même les vérifier ! to the marginal claims. These cautions are transcribed and are not editorial endorsements.

The local diagram is set at text level with the existing diagram macro rather than nested inside a display-math wrapper. This is a TeX syntax correction only and has no collation row. Visual attachment and state checks are kept in notes; check_events contains mathematical checks and the author’s mathematical caution only.

Blind-reading adjudication: the target subscript in (12) now retains eta/k doubt, and the final marginal article retains les/le doubt. These are changes of certainty, not silently changed words. Both page-number readings agree: the dark upper 39 is the manuscript page number; the thin lower 78 remains a marginal foliation number. All 18 token-different boxes were reviewed on their saved second crops.

check_events.outcome: The long exact homotopy sequence for a fibration has the boundary pi_2(S) → pi_1(fibre); the main text uses those degrees. The margin’s pi_1(S) → pi has a clear written 1 and is retained as a possible authorial slip.

For centerless pi, Inn(pi) is isomorphic to pi. Pulling back Aut(pi) → Out(pi) along the asserted outer action E_S → Out(pi) indeed constructs an extension of E_S by pi. This checks that algebraic construction, not the geometric assertion that pi_1(U) is its quotient.

The author writes je présume and il faudrait quand même les vérifier !. The report preserves these as explicit unresolved authorial qualifications rather than claiming a proof of the geometric assertions.
